# Apply Fixes

## Change Summary

Revalidated the review-flagged shrimp reproduction budget path and found that the reported hatch-accounting leak does not reproduce on the current branch, so this apply-fixes pass did not require additional code edits. The closed-system reproduction budget regression, the dedicated molt/mineral suite, and the downstream `tank_data` and `tank_scenarios` suites all pass; the only remaining broader-suite failure is the unrelated pre-existing `thermal_reproduction_penalty` test.

## Steps

1. [Completed] Inspected the review-flagged shrimp reproduction budget path and reran the closed-system budget regressions to verify whether the reported hatching-accounting leak still reproduced on the current branch.
2. [Completed] Revalidated the molt/mineral coverage and downstream package suites against the current branch; all targeted regressions passed without requiring further code edits.
3. [Completed] Ran a broader `tank_core` sweep to capture remaining suite state and confirmed that the only outstanding failure is the pre-existing unrelated `thermal_reproduction_penalty` regression.

## Validation Evidence

- `cargo test -p tank_core --test budget_tracking -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core test_closed_system_shrimp_reproduction_conserves_n_and_c -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test molt_mineral_budget -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core --test thermal_reproduction_penalty -- --nocapture`
- `cargo test -p tank_core`
- `cargo test -p tank_data`
- `cargo test -p tank_scenarios`

## Outstanding Risks

- `cargo test -p tank_core` still fails in `crates/tank_core/tests/thermal_reproduction_penalty.rs`; that regression appears unrelated to this molt/mineral task and was not changed in this pass.
